```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# 205 samples collected; but only 112 sequenced, of which 85 got clinical signs & geocoord metadata (unique(ct_data$animal_id) = 85)
# 17 samples had no questionnaire
# 112 were tested by PCR & RDT; subset to 85 with clinical signs bc those have geo-coordinates
# 134 had a barcode (one was "") - are these unique animals?


# Loading the packages
pacman::p_load(
  rio,
  here,
  sf,
  janitor,
  lubridate,
  epikit,       
  gtsummary,    
  scales,       
  flextable,
  readxl,
  forcats,
  epiR,
  plyr, 
  epitools,
  geepack, 
  marginaleffects,
  ggpubr,
  psych,
  tinytex,
  effectsize,
  RColorBrewer,
  apyramid,
  caret,
  patchwork,
  Hmisc,
  cowplot,
  tidyverse,
  ggh4x
)

```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Loading the datasets that we need for mapping
con_table<- import(here::here("data","clean", "con_table.rds")) #for making the confusion matrix
con_table<- import("data/clean/con_table.rds")

counties <- st_read(here::here("data","clean","gadm41_KEN_1.shp"))
counties <- st_read("data/clean/gadm41_KEN_1.shp")

mapping_data <- import(here::here("data","clean","ct_data1.rds"))
mapping_data <- import("data/clean/ct_data1.rds")

makueni_map <- st_read(here::here("data","clean","Mkn_subcounties.shp"))
siaya_map <- st_read(here::here("data","clean","Siaya_subcounties.shp"))

makueni_map <- st_read("data/clean/Mkn_subcounties.shp")
siaya_map <- st_read("data/clean/Siaya_subcounties.shp")

chosen <- counties |>
  filter(NAME_1 %in% c("Makueni", "Siaya"))

#Kenyan map showing the study counties

  geom_sf(data=counties, aes(geometry=geometry), fill="white")+

# Siaya

st_crs(mapping_siaya) = 4326

siaya_panel <- ggplot()+
```

# Time series

```{r warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE,}

# some samples were taken out bc were not within the study area
combined <- import(here::here("data", "clean", "combined.rds")) # Combined file has 205 sampled animals (130 unique animal IDs & 195 barcodes!) 
combined <- import("data/clean/combined.rds")

# Combined data is 205 rows but the mapping_data is 214
samples_df <- combined  %>%
  mutate(rapid_diagnostic_test = recode(rapid_diagnostic_test,"Positive " = "Positive"),
         RDT = recode(rapid_diagnostic_test,
                      "Positive" = "RDT+",
                      "Negative" = "RDT-",
                      "Inconclusive" = "RDT?"),
         PCR = recode(lab_diagnostics_pcr,
                      "Positive" = "PCR+",
                      "Negative" = "PCR-"),
         test_results = paste(RDT, PCR, sep = ""))

# Example colour palette:
reds <- rev(colorRampPalette(c("#FEE0D2", "#67000D"))(7))
greys <- colorRampPalette(c("#BDBDBD", "#636363"))(4)

results_colors <- c(
  "RDT+" = reds[1],  # reds[1]
  "RDT+PCR+" = reds[2],  # 
  "RDT+PCR-" = reds[3],  # 
  "RDT-PCR+" = reds[4],  # 
  "RDT?PCR+" = reds[5],  # 
  "RDT-PCR-" = greys[1],   # Greys
  "RDT-" = greys[2]   # 
)

# Set the palatte order
outcomes <- names(results_colors)
samples_df <- samples_df %>%
  mutate(test_results = factor(test_results, levels = rev(outcomes)))  # keep all levels

# Pretty plot of Makueni samples
makueni_samples <- samples_df %>%
  filter(county == "Makueni") %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(date_collected),                 # ensure original is Date
    Month = floor_date(Date, "month")) %>%
  count(Month, test_results) %>%           # count number of outcomes per date
  complete(Month = seq(min(Month), max(Month), by = "1 month"),
           test_results = rev(outcomes),
           fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = n, fill = test_results)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw()+
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "4 months",    # show every 3rd month
    date_labels = "%b %Y") +        # e.g. "Jan 2024"
    # limits = c(as.Date("2020-06-01"),as.Date("2022-09-01"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = results_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,20,by=2), limits = c(0,14)) +
  labs(title = "Makueni",
       x = "Month", y = "Tests", fill = "Outcome") +
  theme(text=element_text(size=11), legend.position="none" ) 

# Pretty plot of Siaya samples
siaya_samples <- samples_df %>%
  filter(county == "Siaya") %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(date_collected),                 # ensure original is Date
    Month = floor_date(Date, "month")) %>%
  count(Month, test_results) %>%           # count number of outcomes per date
  complete(Month = seq(min(Month), max(Month), by = "1 month"),
           test_results = rev(outcomes),
           fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = n, fill = test_results)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_bw()+
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "4 months",    # show every 3rd month
    date_labels = "%b %Y") + #,        # e.g. "Jan 2024"
  # limits = c(as.Date("2021-08-01"),as.Date("2022-08-01"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = results_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,20,by=2), limits = c(0,14)) +
  labs(title = "Siaya",
       x = "Month", y = "Tests", fill = "Outcome") +
    theme(text=element_text(size=11), legend.position="left" )

ts_plot <- (siaya_samples | makueni_samples) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 2)) + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') # Reordered panels to map across
ggsave("Figs/Figure_2.png", ts_plot, width = 10, height = 4)

```

# clinical signs

```{r}
# cleaning the contact tracing data 
ct_data <- import(here::here("data", "clean", "ct_data.rds"))
ct_data <- import("data/clean/ct_data.rds")

# figure using the entire dataset (205 samples)
Fig <- ct_data |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, cnty_name, clinical_signs_, lab_diagnostics_pcr, rapid_diagnostic_test, sample_source) |>
  group_by(species, clinical_signs_) |>
  dplyr::count() # Summarized table of data with clinical signs and species; but combinations are missing so zeros would need adding

# Revise to capture zeros- But note this doesn't use animal ID so cases with multiple signs will apppear repeatedly
Fig_new = Fig
for(i in unique(Fig$clinical_signs_)){
  for(j in unique(Fig$species)){
    if(nrow(Fig[Fig$clinical_signs_ == i &
                     Fig$species == j,]) == 0){
      new_row = data.frame(
                  clinical_signs_ = i, 
                  species = j, 
                  n = 0)
      Fig_new = rbind(Fig_new, new_row)
    }
  }
}
dim(Fig_new)

ggplot(data = Fig_new)+
  geom_col(aes(y=n, x = clinical_signs_,fill = species), position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Clinical signs", y = "Number", fill="Species")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", direction = 1)+
  coord_flip()+
  theme_bw() # produces a frequency distributin for each clinical sign, with a bar for each species. 
# But the challenge is that we don't know how many positives were for each species so this can be a bit misleading

ggsave("Figs/Figure_4_supplementary.png", width = 18, height = 12)
#ggsave("/Users/mumbuamutunga/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/Desktop/Sp:Se_Analysis/Sp_Se-analysis/Figs/Figure 4 supplementary.png", 


# Select the sequenced samples
Fig_seq <- ct_data |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, cnty_name, clinical_signs_, lab_diagnostics_pcr, rapid_diagnostic_test, sample_source) |>
  filter(!lab_diagnostics_pcr %in% "") |>
  group_by(species, clinical_signs_) |>
  dplyr::count()

# Make the code clearer - identif the unique clinical signs and species
clinical_signs <- unique(Fig_seq$clinical_signs_)
species <- unique(Fig_seq$species)

Fig_seq_new <- Fig_seq %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(
    clinical_signs_ = clinical_signs,
    species = species,
    fill = list(n = 0)
  )

# Reorder clinical_signs_ by total frequency (n) in ascending order
Fig_new_seq <- Fig_seq_new %>%
  group_by(clinical_signs_) %>%
  mutate(total_n = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(clinical_signs_ = reorder(clinical_signs_, total_n))

ggplot(data = Fig_new_seq) + # stacked barplot of the clinical signs by species (without indicating the lab diagnostic result)
  geom_col(aes(x = clinical_signs_, y = n, fill = species), position = "stack")+
  labs(x = "Clinical signs", y = "Number", fill = "Species") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", direction = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
   theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 16),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold")
  ) # looks like almost 80/ total animals were aggresive while <5 had some of the rarer signs.... but lacks denominator so hard to interpret

ggsave("Figs/Figure-4.png", width = 15, height = 10)
```

# data with RDT & clinical signs

```{r echo=FALSE}
# assume the 195 barcodes from the combined dataset are the unique IDs from the original sampled animals
# extract the unique barcodes and their corresponding clinical signs, RDT results, and PCR results

table(combined$rapid_diagnostic_test, combined$lab_diagnostics_pcr) # Shows the distribution of RDT & PCR results across the 205 samples; # 113 had both results, 92 had RDT only
# ct_data has 85 unique animal IDs with clinical signs and PCR results; and 134 unique barcodes 
# the ct_data also has a row for each clinical sign but there are multiple ones per animal!

#take the barcode, PCR and RDT results from the combined dataset and add each clinical sign as a column with a 1 or 0.

# Clean up the animal species names
ct_data$animal_species = factor(
  case_match(
    ct_data$animal_species,
    "Caprine" ~ "Caprine",
    "Ovine" ~ "Ovine",
    "Canine" ~ "Canine",
    "Bovine" ~ "Bovine",
    "" ~ "Unknown",
    "Feline" ~ "Feline",
    "Wild  Animal (Honey Badger)" ~ "Mustelid"
  ),
  levels = rev(c("Canine", "Feline", "Bovine", "Caprine", "Ovine", "Mustelid", "Unknown"))
)

combined$animal_species = factor(
  case_match(
    combined$animal_species,
    "Caprine" ~ "Goat",
    "Ovine" ~ "Sheep",
    "Equine" ~ "Equid",
    "Canine" ~ "Dog",
    "Bovine" ~ "Cow",
    "Jackal" ~ "Jackal",
    "" ~ "Unknown",
    "Feline" ~ "Cat",
    "Matalani" ~ "Unknown",
    "Wild  Animal (Honey Badger)" ~ "Honey badger"
  ),
  levels = rev(c("Dog", "Cat", "Cow", "Goat", "Sheep", "Honey badger", "Unknown"))
)

# Take the ct_data which has 1 row per clincal sign - reformat it by lab results
barcode_results <- ct_data |>
  select(bar_code, animal_species, rapid_diagnostic_test, lab_diagnostics_pcr) |>
  mutate(
    rdt = case_when(
      rapid_diagnostic_test == "Positive" ~ 1,
      rapid_diagnostic_test == "Negative" ~ 0,
      is.na(rapid_diagnostic_test) | rapid_diagnostic_test == "" ~ NA_real_
    ),
    pcr = case_when(
      lab_diagnostics_pcr == "Positive" ~ 1,
      lab_diagnostics_pcr == "Negative" ~ 0,
      is.na(lab_diagnostics_pcr) | lab_diagnostics_pcr == "" ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) |>
  select(bar_code, animal_species, rdt, pcr) |>
  distinct(bar_code, .keep_all = TRUE)
dim(barcode_results) # 134 unique barcodes with RDT and PCR results

clinical_wide <- ct_data |>
  select(bar_code, clinical_signs_) |>
  filter(clinical_signs_ != "" & !is.na(clinical_signs_)) |>
  mutate(present = 1) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = clinical_signs_,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0,
    values_fn   = max
  )
clinical_sign_cols <- names(clinical_wide)[-1]  # drops bar_code

barcode_results <- barcode_results |>
  left_join(clinical_wide, by = "bar_code")

barcode_results <- barcode_results |> # automatically use NA if all 4 results not available
  mutate(
    `RDT+PCR+` = if_else(rdt == 1 & pcr == 1, 1, 0),
    `RDT+PCR-` = if_else(rdt == 1 & pcr == 0, 1, 0),
    `RDT-PCR+` = if_else(rdt == 0 & pcr == 1, 1, 0),
    `RDT-PCR-` = if_else(rdt == 0 & pcr == 0, 1, 0)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(rdt) & !is.na(pcr)) # filters out those without RDT & PCR results - gives 79 only!

# now take the combined data and just take the barcode, and convert the RDT & PCR results to 1/0, and get the test combo columns 
bc_results <- combined |> # 195 samples (108 with PCR and 87 without)
  select(bar_code, animal_species, rapid_diagnostic_test, lab_diagnostics_pcr) |>
  filter(!is.na(rapid_diagnostic_test) & !is.na(lab_diagnostics_pcr)) |>
  mutate(
    rdt = case_when(
      rapid_diagnostic_test == "Positive" ~ 1,
      rapid_diagnostic_test == "Negative" ~ 0
    ),
    pcr = case_when(
      lab_diagnostics_pcr == "Positive" ~ 1,
      lab_diagnostics_pcr == "Negative" ~ 0
    ),
    `RDT+PCR+` = if_else(rdt == 1 & pcr == 1, 1, 0),
    `RDT+PCR-` = if_else(rdt == 1 & pcr == 0, 1, 0),
    `RDT-PCR+` = if_else(rdt == 0 & pcr == 1, 1, 0),
    `RDT-PCR-` = if_else(rdt == 0 & pcr == 0, 1, 0)
  ) |>
  select(bar_code, animal_species, rdt, pcr, `RDT+PCR+`, `RDT+PCR-`, `RDT-PCR+`, `RDT-PCR-`) |>
  distinct(bar_code, .keep_all = TRUE)

bc_results <- bc_results |>
  left_join(clinical_wide, by = "bar_code") |>
  filter(!is.na(pcr)) # filters out those without both RDT and PCR results - so gives 79 only!

# select the sign order from those seen most often in RDT+/PCR+ animals:
sign_order <- barcode_results |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(clinical_sign_cols),
    names_to  = "clinical_sign",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  filter(present == 1, `RDT+PCR+` == 1) |>
  count(clinical_sign, sort = TRUE) |>
  pull(clinical_sign)

# now make stacked barcharts of the clinical signs by the test result combinations (RDT+PCR+, RDT+PCR-, RDT-PCR+, RDT-PCR-) 
barcode_denominators <- barcode_results |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(`RDT+PCR+`, `RDT+PCR-`, `RDT-PCR+`, `RDT-PCR-`),
    names_to  = "test_combo",
    values_to = "in_combo"
  ) |>
  filter(in_combo == 1) |>
  count(test_combo, name = "total_animals")

bc_denominators <- bc_results |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(`RDT+PCR+`, `RDT+PCR-`, `RDT-PCR+`, `RDT-PCR-`),
    names_to  = "test_combo",
    values_to = "in_combo"
  ) |>
  filter(in_combo == 1) |>
  count(test_combo, name = "total_animals")

####################
barcode_res_plot <- barcode_results |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(clinical_sign_cols),
    names_to  = "clinical_sign",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  filter(present == 1) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(`RDT+PCR+`, `RDT+PCR-`, `RDT-PCR+`, `RDT-PCR-`),
    names_to  = "test_combo",
    values_to = "in_combo"
  ) |>
  filter(in_combo == 1) |>
  mutate(
    clinical_sign = factor(clinical_sign, levels = sign_order),
    test_combo    = factor(test_combo, levels = c("RDT+PCR+", "RDT+PCR-", "RDT-PCR+", "RDT-PCR-"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = clinical_sign, fill = animal_species)) +
  geom_blank(aes(y = 10)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  geom_hline(data = barcode_denominators, aes(yintercept = total_animals),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
#  facet_wrap(~ test_combo, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  facet_grid(test_combo ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(5)) +
  labs(
    x     = "",
    y     = "Count",
    fill  = "Species",
    title = "" #Clinical Signs by Test Result Combination
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
ggsave("Figs/Figure_barcode.png", barcode_res_plot, width = 6, height = 10)

####################
bc_res_plot <- bc_results |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(clinical_sign_cols),
    names_to  = "clinical_sign",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  filter(present == 1) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(`RDT+PCR+`, `RDT+PCR-`, `RDT-PCR+`, `RDT-PCR-`),
    names_to  = "test_combo",
    values_to = "in_combo"
  ) |>
  filter(in_combo == 1) |>
  mutate(
    clinical_sign = factor(clinical_sign, levels = sign_order),

  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = clinical_sign, fill = animal_species)) +
  geom_blank(aes(y = 10)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  geom_hline(data = bc_denominators, aes(yintercept = total_animals),
             linetype = "dashed", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
#  facet_wrap(~ test_combo, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  facet_grid(test_combo ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(5)) +
  labs(
    x     = "",
    y     = "Count",
    fill  = "Species",
    title = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
ggsave("Figs/Figure_bc.png", bc_res_plot, width = 6.5, height = 9.5)

# Just do a heat map of the data:
sign_freq_order <- barcode_results |>
  select(all_of(clinical_sign_cols)) |>
  colSums() |>
  sort(decreasing = TRUE) |>
  names()

# clinical sign heat map by test combo
barcode_heatmaps <- barcode_results |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(clinical_sign_cols),
    names_to  = "clinical_sign",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(`RDT+PCR+`, `RDT+PCR-`, `RDT-PCR+`, `RDT-PCR-`),
    names_to  = "test_combo",
    values_to = "in_combo"
  ) |>
  filter(in_combo == 1) |>
  mutate(
    clinical_sign = factor(clinical_sign, levels = sign_freq_order),
    test_combo    = factor(test_combo, levels = rev(c("RDT+PCR+", "RDT+PCR-", "RDT-PCR+", "RDT-PCR-")))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = clinical_sign, y = bar_code, fill = factor(present))) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("0" = "grey90", "1" = "steelblue"),
    labels = c("0" = "Absent", "1" = "Present")
  ) +
  facet_grid(test_combo ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x     = "Clinical Sign",
    y     = "Barcode",
    fill  = NULL,
    title = "Clinical Signs per Animal by Test Result"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )
ggsave("Figs/Figure_barcode_heatmaps.png", barcode_heatmaps, width = 5, height = 12)
```

```{r}
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
  )

p

p_labeled <- ggdraw(p) +
  draw_plot_label(
    label = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    x = c(0.20, 0.60, 0.20, 0.60),   # slightly inside panels
    y = c(0.98, 0.98, 0.50, 0.50),   # slightly below top
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    size = 16,
    fontface = "bold"
  )
p_labeled

ggsave("Figs/Figure_5.png",plot = p_labeled, width = 14, height = 10)

  filter(rapid_diagnostic_test == "Positive",
         county %in% c("Makueni", "Siaya")) |>
  mutate(year = format(date_collected, "%Y")) |>
```
